[b]The South Crumbles but the North Remains: October-November 2026[/b]
The former Principate (now Kingdom) of Equestria had watched with deep unease as the former Holy Orthodox Empire fell into the hands of the revolutionary rabble, led by a former peach farmer, they watched as the bourgeoise and patrician attempted to cling to the power that Thývenic society had granted them. Thýven, once a strong ally of Equestria, had now seemingly fallen into the hands of the enemy, attrition. As a result the estates of Equestria, fearing a spread of revolution to Equestrian itself, petitioned the two monarchs to look into adopting a more modern form of social state, Equestria was small enough, united enough, and had the resources thus to establish a social state in of its own right, thereby, quelling revolution with "candy" from the government.

Thus, the two kings of Equestria would permit the establishment of a National Institute for Health and Social Services (NIHS) in Equestria, run by the church, drawing from Montfleurois ideals, the two kings would see this as a win for Equestrian neutrality and moderation. In the meantime they sought to bolster the armed forces, once dependent on Thýven, Equestria now had realised that the levies had to be united and a formal national army built. Thus plans were drawn up by the estates to begin training and forming a cohesive command structure to establish a formal Royal Equestrian Guard.
